candidates.title: The Canal Gate That Would Not Close
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered the irrigation gate would not seal before the evening release before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they tightened the handle but water still rushed beneath it; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized a fallen branch was wedged inside the lower track; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they lifted the branch with a hooked pole and closed the gate safely, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: The Bakery Bell That Rang Twice
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered the bakery bell rang twice for every delivery before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they replaced its rope but the double ring remained; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized a swinging sign struck the bell on the return stroke; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they fastened the sign and tested the bell with the delivery team, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
